result.summary: The environment is a commercial corridor with basic sidewalk infrastructure but a complete lack of formal pedestrian crossing facilities at the intersection. Pedestrians must navigate wide, unmarked expanses of pavement with no traffic control or accessibility features like curb ramps.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated path or driver awareness.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the side street and main road

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps creates a significant barrier for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface on the side street is cracked and uneven, presenting a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, side street entrance

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded asphalt on the side street to provide a smooth walking surface.

result.summary: The environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway with a high-speed design and minimal pedestrian infrastructure. While a sidewalk exists on one side and a school crossing sign is present, the lack of marked crosswalks and the long unprotected crossing distance create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is exceptionally wide with no median or refuge, forcing pedestrians to remain exposed to traffic for a long duration.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway in the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: Despite a school crossing warning sign, there are no painted crosswalks visible to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to a specific crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Near the school crossing sign on the right side of the road.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes with minimal vertical or horizontal friction encourage vehicle speeds that are unsafe for a residential/school area.
hazards.location_in_image: The main travel lanes stretching into the distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection and near the school zone sign.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a two-lane roadway with a sidewalk separated by a grass buffer on the far side. The environment lacks any designated pedestrian crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or signals, which increases risk for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.description: There are no designated or marked locations for pedestrians to cross the two-lane roadway, forcing uncontrolled crossings.
